options.content: Runtime health from persisted events. Prometheus scrape status is shown separately so a failed `/metrics` socket does not make the whole overview blank.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  ((e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange']) || ' ' || (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol'])) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  AND (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange']) IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol']) IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no frames' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no frames' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (e.actor_id || ' ' || e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no decisions' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no decisions' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 4)
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_ms' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 3)
  ELSE kv.key
END AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND kv.key <> 'best_epoch'
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no stage timings' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no stage timings' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'latency_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'latency_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('ExecutionSyncCompleted', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND e.payload->>'latency_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(e.payload->>'latency_ms') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no sync latency' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no sync latency' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'ExecutionSyncRequested'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no sync requests' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no sync requests' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(1.0) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersAccepted'
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no placed orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no placed orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END || ' ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), 'unknown')) AS metric,
  SUM(1.0) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersFailed'
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no failed orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no failed orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' || COALESCE(e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' || CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(1.0) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'private:state:%:fills'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no fills' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no fills' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' || COALESCE(e.symbol, 'unknown') || ' ' || CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'private:state:%:fills'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no filled qty' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no filled qty' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

WITH expanded AS (
  SELECT
    e.ts,
    COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS exchange,
    COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], e.symbol, 'unknown') AS symbol,
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','side'], '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload->'live_orders', '{}'::jsonb)) AS open_order(key, value)
  WHERE e.topic LIKE 'execution:state:%'
    AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], e.symbol, '') IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
per_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    ts,
    exchange,
    symbol,
    side,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM expanded
  GROUP BY ts, exchange, symbol, side
)
SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' ' || side) AS metric,
  AVG(value) AS value
FROM per_snapshot
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no live orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no live orders' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

WITH expanded AS (
  SELECT
    e.ts,
    COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS exchange,
    COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], e.symbol, 'unknown') AS symbol,
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','side'], '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload->'live_orders', '{}'::jsonb)) AS open_order(key, value)
  WHERE e.topic LIKE 'execution:state:%'
    AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], e.symbol, '') IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
per_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    ts,
    exchange,
    symbol,
    side,
    SUM(qty) AS value
  FROM expanded
  GROUP BY ts, exchange, symbol, side
)
SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' ' || side) AS metric,
  AVG(value) AS value
FROM per_snapshot
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no live order qty' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time", 'no live order qty' AS metric, 0.0 AS value
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts, e.actor_id, e.exchange, e.symbol, w.warning
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w(warning)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 25
